integrating AI/LLM capabilities into product experiences responsibly

parsed.notes:
Required Skills sets required labels; Preferred Qualifications sets optional labels.
AI-native use across the SDLC maps to AI Coding Tools; integrating AI/LLM capabilities into products is a separate preferred ask.
Architectural direction is labeled from Preferred Qualifications; architecture, testing, security, and other practices mentioned only in responsibilities do not create additional requirements.
Reliability best practices is an explicit technical-practice requirement without a matching taxonomy entry.
AI/LLM names broad AI and LLM capabilities rather than interchangeable alternatives; no alternative groups apply.
